title: Donne mie, la fate a tanti
subtitle: Guglielmo: aria from Così fan tutte, Act 2 (No. 26)

passages.label: Donne mie, la fate a tanti · Io vo bene al sesso vostro
Ma quel farla a tanti · Mille volte il brando presi
Siete vaghe, siete amabili · Ma la fate a tanti · Io vo bene
Ma la fate a tanti · Hanno certo un gran perchè (to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 8, No. 26 Aria

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (sà, perchè, diè, vo without its apostrophe; segno d'amistà where the libretto has marche; sino ai piè where it has fino; a tanti e tanti; Ma ma ma, printed Ma... ma... ma..., given without the dots, as the libretto has none).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 268–274, bars 1–176 of No. 26
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung line and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out; in bar 125 a note that carries only a German syllable is left out. The cut signs at “vi-” (bar 59) and “-de” (bar 85), and again at bars 108 and 136, are not written in the score. Bars 1–11 and 170–176 are for the piano alone. Playback tempo ♩ = 112, estimated from Jacobs (3:33, which includes the end of the recitative); Mozart gives the word Allegretto only.
